messages:
anika: starting marble11b int4 canary. seeing sporadic OOMs on long QA prompts when prefetch enabled. tagging infra.

ron: hosted or dedicated canary? which GPU family?

anika: dedicated (p4d-like). failure about 1 in 12. stack points to kv prefetch allocation spike causing cudaMalloc OOM.

lucas: what are batch and max_new_tokens right now? prefetch + big max_new_tokens common culprit.

anika: defaults: batch=3, max_new_tokens=192, prefetch=true.

mai: quick mitigations: 1) lower max_new_tokens to 64 for canary; 2) flip prefetch heuristic to kv_trim/kv_walk so we don't eagerly bulk-alloc cold keys.

anika: applied: set model default.max_new_tokens=64 for canary and pool batch=1. leaving prefetch on to measure latency.

infra-bot: [alert] canary marble11b v0.3.2 failure-rate=3.6%. automated rollback kicked at 6570000020.

anika: rollback occurred. post-rollback we still saw one sporadic spike. allocator stats (sanitized): heap_total=24GB, fragmentation=0.75, compaction_runs_last_min=0, freelist_depth=8.

ron: compactor threshold is 0.8 by default; looks like frag is just below. consider lowering frag_threshold to 0.68 for canary and enable micro-defrag before prefetch.

lucas: also safe to enable prefetch.defrag=true and add rollout guard: if p95_latency_delta>25ms OR failure_rate>1% for 5m then disable prefetch for that model/pool.

anika: set pool feature allocator.frag_threshold=0.68 and model config allocator.defrag_before_prefetch=true. created rollout guard policy.

anika: post-change: ran 8k requests, zero OOMs; p95 latency +14ms. quality eval queued to check QA metrics with reduced max_new_tokens.

mai: schedule the eval and if EM drop >0.5% revert max_new_tokens or try dynamic max_new by prompt length.

infra-bot: [info] eval queued id=eval-6570000100.

lucas: good containment. propose onboarding defaults: batch=1, max_new_tokens=64, frag_threshold=0.68, defrag_before_prefetch=true, prefetch.heuristic=kv_trim.

anika: noted. will update onboarding doc and follow up with eval results. thanks all. :rocket:
